title: Your all-stock portfolio: 20 researched companies chosen from the whole S&P 500.
lede: You asked for an all-stock portfolio chosen from the whole S&P 500. Every company got a quick research pass; 268 got full SEC-filing research so far. The 20 stocks held are the best of 172 that passed every test: good businesses whose price does not assume more growth than the evidence supports. That rule keeps out Microsoft, NVIDIA, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Apple at today's prices. Honest odds: no rule tested here beat the S&P 500 over 2012–2026, so treat beating it as a coin flip, not a promise. The price of going all-stock is risk: the 20 fell −49% in the 2007–09 replay.
tiles: chance of a gain over 5 years (base case)
chance of beating the S&P 500 over 5 years (no assumed edge)
independent bets, once co-movement is counted
